description: ESP32 Task Watchdog Timer reset due to blocking code
serial_logs:
I (321) cpu_start: Starting scheduler on PRO CPU.
I (321) cpu_start: Starting scheduler on APP CPU.
I (321) task_wdt: Task watchdog got triggered. The following tasks did not reset the watchdog in time:
I (321) task_wdt:  - IDLE0 (CPU 0)
E (321) task_wdt: Task watchdog got triggered. The following tasks did not reset the watchdog in time:
E (321) task_wdt:  - IDLE1 (CPU 1)
E (321) task_wdt: Abort was called at PC 0x4008abcd on core 0

Guru Meditation Error: Core  0 panic'ed (Interrupt wdt timeout on CPU0).

Rebooting...
user_question: Why does the ESP32 keep rebooting with watchdog timeout?
expected_root_cause: Task watchdog timeout - code blocks in loop without calling esp_task_wdt_reset() or yielding
expected_fix: Add esp_task_wdt_reset() in the loop or use vTaskDelay() to yield

expected_code_issues.suggestion: Replace busy-wait with vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(1000)) or call esp_task_wdt_reset() periodically

expected_serial_log_events.message: Task watchdog got triggered - IDLE tasks not resetting watchdog
expected_serial_log_events.evidence: Task watchdog got triggered. The following tasks did not reset the watchdog in time: - IDLE0 (CPU 0)
expected_serial_log_events.likely_cause: Blocking code prevents watchdog feed; IDLE task starved
expected_serial_log_events.suggested_action: Use vTaskDelay() instead of busy-wait loops; ensure watchdog is fed
